title: Per-call and campaign AI analysis, live mission control, reporting
grades: M measured by us (n, method) | C computed | O observed (capture, API read-back, code) | V vendor-claimed | I inferred | U unknown
note: Thresholds marked I are proposed defaults to recalibrate on the first design-partner data. Carrier-code mappings are standard SIP / Q.850 semantics; which code each Indian carrier (Plivo, Exotel, Vobiz) actually returns for DND, CLI/DLT and announcements is U until task T4 and live calls run.

pipeline_after_hangup.what: hang-up event, engineering reason, carrier code (SIP status, Q.850 cause, provider cause name)
cost lines metered per second in INR (telephony, ears, brain incl. cached/speculative, voice, platform, analysis)
transcript of record: ASR finals ordered by audio offset (HV law 29), \p{M} kept, non-speech probe flags, romanised copy by deterministic transliteration (no LLM, no cost)

code analyses: agenda-ledger completion, per-turn latency segments, cut-ins and overlaps from the stereo channels, heard-vs-planned text, person-reading state per turn, reply-door interventions, compliance trace, clause-at-hang-up
one LLM analysis pass (cached instructions): summary, outcome extraction with spans, objections with spans, commitments with spans, memory proposals with spans, next action
span verification in code: every quote must be an exact substring of the stored transcript at the cited offset; failures are dropped and counted
outcome reconciliation: when the CRM disposition, payment or booking event arrives, the outcome becomes verified and judge agreement is updated
signed webhooks, CRM write-back (confirmed / not_executed / unknown; unknown never auto-retried)
monitors evaluate; issues opened or updated; Supervisor and Operator notified

analysis_cost.basis: C: 3,000 cached instruction tokens at INR 2.85/M + 1,800 transcript tokens at INR 28.5/M + 450 output tokens at INR 237.5/M (gemini-3.5-flash-lite list price, research/2026-10-18/lanes/g3-cascade-measured/results/cost_inputs.csv)
analysis_cost.translation_policy: only when someone opens the English view or exports with translation; cached; shown in the analysis cost line
analysis_cost.contrast: Retell AI QA USD 0.10/min = INR 9.5/min, INR 28.5 for a 3-min call (O price RET-58; C arithmetic at FX 95)
analysis_cost.target: default analysis at or below INR 0.20 per connected call, inside the all-in price; never a separate per-minute QA fee

health_strip_rules: 0 monitors on: 'Monitoring is off for this campaign. We can't tell you it is healthy.' plus Turn on defaults
monitors on, no data yet: 'Watching 20 things. Nothing to judge yet (0 calls).'
monitors on, a monitor has never been read back: that monitor shows 'not live yet' (HV law 21)
monitors on, data flowing, 0 open issues: 'Watching 20 things, last check 12 s ago, 0 open issues' (never 'Great news' or 'all good')

statistics_rules.observed_not_causal: every driver (segment, hour, number, voice, version outside an experiment) carries this label; only randomised experiments in the learning module may say 'caused'
statistics_rules.under_powered: a difference is shown as a finding only when its 95% interval excludes 0 and each group has 100+ units; else 'under-powered: about N more calls per group', N from the two-proportion formula at alpha 0.05, power 0.8 (reproduces l6: 15%->10% = 686, 50%->55% = 1,565)
statistics_rules.hazard_flag: a moment is flagged when P(hazard > 1.25x the expected curve) >= 0.99 and 50+ callers reached it (l6 s.4.8); 2x lines are found 19% / 67% / 94% at 100 / 500 / 1,000 calls (C)
statistics_rules.no_winner_badges: no 'winner' or 'best variant' badge from daily two-arm comparisons (rejected.2026-10-17.k2-dashboards)
statistics_rules.label_noise: an extracted label at 90% accuracy needs 1.8-2.4x more calls in any test (l6 L09); the power meter applies the measured inflation

judges_default.name: Summary
judges_default.type: text, 60 words max, in English plus the client's working language

judges_default.name: Agenda done
judges_default.type: per must/nice item: done, partly, not reached

judges_default.name: Outcome
judges_default.type: client-defined values, e.g. renewal_paid, promised_with_date, needs_human, not_interested, wrong_person
judges_default.source: system of record when wired (verified); LLM extraction with spans as provisional

judges_default.name: Mood path
judges_default.type: start and end state plus turns where it changed (hurried, irritated, worried, chatty, confused, calm)
judges_default.source: code signals (rate, loudness vs baseline, overlaps, lexical cues) plus LLM label

judges_default.name: Objections
judges_default.type: list with exact quotes and offsets

judges_default.name: Commitments
judges_default.type: who promised what by when, with quote
judges_default.source: LLM, spans verified; company-side commitments need approval

judge_rules: created visible and editable at agent creation (contrast: Bolna creates two judges and hides them from list endpoints, evidence.2026-10-20.acct-bolna-auto-judges)
each judge has a version: dated model id, prompt hash, temperature 0; an edit creates a new version and re-baselines trends
a judge never sees the agent version or experiment arm
preference-style judgements use a model family different from the agent's brain; outcome labels are extractions with spans, not grades

Trusted only at agreement 0.90 or more with a Wilson 95% lower bound of 0.80 or more on 50+ paired calls (about 46 of 50, or 88 of 100; C); re-audited monthly on a 5% sample and after any model change
until Trusted, the label shows as 'AI guess' and cannot feed experiments or the north-star number
export_schema_per_campaign: final dial reason code + business reason
recording link (signed, expires in 7 days, access audited)
cost INR (per call and per contact)

webhooks.payload: slim (ids, status, reason, outcome, cost) with a signed fetch link; full payload optional
webhooks.retries: 8 attempts over 24 h, exponential backoff, idempotency key per event
webhooks.replay: 30 days, from the developer page or by API/MCP
webhooks.auto_disable: after 50 consecutive failures, with an Issue (contrast ElevenLabs: 10+ failures)

crm_write_back.v1_targets: the design partners' CRMs (candidates: LeadSquared, Zoho, Salesforce; chosen with the first three partners)
crm_write_back.status: confirmed | not_executed | unknown; unknown is never auto-retried (HV law 17)
crm_write_back.mapping: the Data steward proposes a field mapping; the client approves it once

states.empty: explains the concept and offers one action ('No calls yet. Place a test call and this page fills in.')
states.zero: real zero with its reasons ('0 connected of 120 dialled: 74 switched off, 46 no answer')
states.loading: skeleton plus what is happening and how long ('Analysing 12 calls, about 20 s')
states.failed: names the cause and a retry ('Could not load: analysis service timed out. Retry. Status')
states.not_measured: 'not measured' with why ('no handset recording on this call'), never 0
states.under_powered: 'under-powered: about N more calls per group'
states.sample: diagonal SAMPLE watermark, a toggle, never mixed with real rows
states.stale: freshness stamp on every number ('updated 14 s ago')
states.redacted: masked by role, with who can see it
